body:
Dear Friend,
We need your products urgently. Payment will be made by USDT or Bitcoin only.
Please send invoice immediately and use a private account for faster settlement.
Waiting for your urgent reply.
reply:
Dear Friend,

Thank you for your message. However, we cannot proceed with your request at this stage as we need additional information to ensure a safe transaction. Please confirm your country of origin and the delivery address for the products you require.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
